senses.gloss: कैमर्थक्य n. asking the reason (किम्-अर्थम्, ‘why?’), Pat. on Pāṇ. iii, 1, 46 Vārtt. 1 and 2, 127 Vārtt. 1; Bādar. i, 3, 33, Sch.
कैमर्थ्य n. id., Pāṇ. i, 4, 3; Pat. (˚थक्य ed. K.), Pratāpar.; Kāvyād. ii, 123, Sch.
कैमायनि m. patr. fr. किम्, Pat. on Pāṇ. iv, 1, 93, Vārtt. 13.
कैमुतिक mfn. relating to or based on the ‘how much more?’ or ‘how much less? (किम् उत)’, only in comp.
कैमुतिक—न्याय m. the rule of ‘how much more?’ or ‘how much less?’ arguing a fortiori, Kuval.; Saṃskārak. Comm. on Kir. vii, 27 and BhP. x, 33, 30.
कैमुत्य n. the relation of ‘how much more?’ or ‘how much less?’, Kuval.
कैमुत्य—न्याय m. = ˚तिक-न्य्˚ (q.v.), Pratāpar. Comm. on BhP.
